_comment: Golden blend values shared by comfy_extras/compositor_blend.py and layerBlend.frag. Inputs are unpremultiplied colours already in the blend space; outputs are unclamped (the compositor clamps once, at the end). 'channel' rows are [i, l, out] applied per channel; 'hsl' rows are [rgb_backdrop, rgb_layer, rgb_out]. Regenerate with tests-unit/comfy_extras_test/compositor_blend_fixture_gen.py.
